title: Pruning via Causal Attribution Preserves Reasoning Performance in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.19350v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning but incur substantial inference cost. We introduce Causal Attribution Pruning (CAP), a training-free method that identifies critical attention heads by measuring their causal impact on reasoning tasks and uses these head-level scores to guide fine-grained weight pruning. For each attention head, CAP estimates the expected performance degradation when the head is masked during forward passes on a small calibration set of reasoning problems. These causal scores are then converted into weight-level importance values for the corresponding projection matrices. Unlike magnitude-only or activation-based criteria, CAP's interventional measurement directly captures each head's functional contribution, yielding relative accuracy gains of up to 61% over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity. We evaluate CAP on GSM8K, StrategyQA, and ARC-Challenge using Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7

translated_title: 通过因果归因剪枝保持大型语言模型的推理性能
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在多步推理方面表现出色，但会产生高昂的推理成本。我们提出了因果归因剪枝（Causal Attribution Pruning, CAP），这是一种无需训练的方法，通过测量注意力头对推理任务的因果影响来识别关键的注意力头，并利用这些头级别的分数来指导细粒度的权重剪枝。对于每个注意力头，CAP 在一个由推理问题组成的小型校准集上进行前向传播时，估计将该注意力头掩蔽后的预期性能下降，随后将这些因果分数转换为相应投影矩阵的权重级重要性值。与仅基于权重大小或基于激活的剪枝准则不同，CAP 的干预式测量能够直接捕捉每个注意力头的功能性贡献，在 20% 稀疏度下于 ARC-Challenge 上相比 Wanda 取得了高达 61% 的相对准确率提升。我们使用 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7 模型在 GSM8K、StrategyQA 和 ARC-Challenge 上对 CAP 进行了评估。
tldr: 提出无需训练的因果归因剪枝方法 CAP，通过干预式测量注意力头对推理任务的因果贡献来指导细粒度权重剪枝，在 20% 稀疏度下相比 Wanda 在 ARC-Challenge 上获得高达 61% 的相对准确率提升，从而在降低推理成本的同时有效保持大语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: CAP is a training-free pruning method that measures the causal impact of attention heads on reasoning tasks to guide fine-grained weight pruning, achieving up to 61% relative accuracy gains over Wanda on ARC-Challenge at 20% sparsity while preserving LLM reasoning performance.
